notes: One course per grade as the taxonomy files them: Algebra I = 9, Geometry = 10, Algebra II = 11, Precalculus and Advanced Topics = 12. Built from each module's Module Overview table of contents (module, topic and lesson titles; topic standards kept in 'standards'). A lesson spanning days is numbered like '22–23'. Eight lesson titles whose math was typeset as equations (lost in the text extraction) were restored by hand, e.g. 'f(x) = ax² + bx + c'. Unit URLs point at the per-module zip on archive.org, lesson URLs at the teacher PDF (NYSED's own EngageNY archive page could not be reached). Skill ids are our best match per topic; a topic maps to another grade's skill when the fit is clearly there (e.g. Geometry's laws of sines and cosines → m.12.law-sines-cosines); lessons carry skills only when their topic maps to exactly one skill; 'notes' says where the fit is loose or there is no skill.
